verdicts.reason: A: the cream card covers almost the whole canvas, so the confetti brand texture survives only as thin edge strips. The 'Quiet Hours' book is shrunk to an unreadable thumbnail beside a tiny, buried CTA, and a large dead gap sits between the legal line and that bottom row. The eyebrow has also dropped below the body copy, and the logo is cramped. B: the card fills the canvas and the confetti is almost gone, cropped at the edges. The CTA floats above the headline, out of reading order and not aligned with it. The body copy leaves 'night.' orphaned on its own line, and the logo is shrunk into the bottom-left corner next to fine print, with empty space below the book. B still keeps the book as large, recognisable imagery and has a readable CTA, so it is marginally less broken.
